changes: Edited /agent/solver.md (validate OK). Added a budget plan (about 6 calls to derive and code, 3 to test and fix, and 3 reserved for the brute-force and max-size timing checks, batched into one run_python). Added a rule never to submit a stub or known-incomplete program, with instructions to reduce and brute-force-probe the problem instead. Added short hints for the failure types seen in the report: XOR union-find with per-bit majority for minimizing sums, prefix counts for occupancy problems, and a check of the brute force when a wrong answer appears with samples passing. Motivation: the report showed 96/96 submissions, with the ones that failed either submitting after sample checks only or submitting a placeholder (arc193-d). One trial on lcb-arc193-d still failed (time limit exceeded). It submitted a heuristic that passed the samples, so the stub rule did not fix that case. I stopped there rather than spend the remaining trials on one problem.
final:
